## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way? Describe the problem before the solution —
concrete examples of queries or repositories help a lot.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to see. If it changes behaviour described in [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md), say
which decision it touches and why the current one is not enough.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought of, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Anything else — examples, links, related issues.
